about: ws-options-verify --render capacity pins (tests/lib/options-render.cjs capacityPin). A value listed here may print fewer items on its fullest page than the default page because the OWNER has ruled on that cost; it is reported as debt, not a FAIL. Only the capacity comparison is pinned. Each entry cites its ruling. Remove an entry when the ruling changes.

divForm.why: owner ruling (Lane D restart, 2026-10-31; lead ruling 2026-11-03, Lane D R4 prep): the written form is the owner's notation choice and he accepted notation-driven capacity changes; the long-division bracket stays at 10 columns (owner). Measured: S vertical 25 vs 30; L long / fraction / mix 15 vs 16, vertical 12 vs 16

form.why: owner ruling 2026-11-07 (lf-placevalue Q4, "Yes, accept all four", via the lead): the longer written answer is the form being taught; the page stays full at its own column count. Measured r0: S 10 vs 20, L 4 vs 12

zeroPlace.why: owner ruling 2026-11-07 (lf-placevalue R3, "Yes, accept 10", via the lead): with no zero place every item has three parts and is wider than the mixed default page; the longer written answer is the form being taught. Measured r2: L 10 vs 11

form.why: owner ruling 2026-11-07 (lf-placevalue Q4, "Yes, accept all four", via the lead): the longer written answer is the form being taught; the page stays full at its own column count. Measured r0: unit S 12 vs 30, L 6 vs 12; notation S 16 vs 30, L 10 vs 12

response.why: owner ruling 2026-11-07 (lf-placevalue Q4, "Yes, accept all four", via the lead): the longer written answer is the form being taught; the page stays full at its own column count. Measured r0: bank L 8 vs 10 (the word bank is a drawn box)

jumps.why: count-row card §9 Q2(b) and §7a jumps (signed 2026-11-07, lane decision under owner rule 2026-11-07): 15 numbers (three lines of 5) fit fewer rows a page - an accepted cost while H13 holds. Measured (lf-ops 2026-11-07): S 6 vs 8, L 4 vs 6. The shape pages hold the default's rows since the shaped tiles keep the box pitch (lf-ops count-row fix)
